caseName: Wagner v. International Brotherhood of Electricians, Local No. 1305
caseNameFull: WAGNER v. INTERNATIONAL BROTHERHOOD OF ELECTRICIANS, LOCAL NO. 1305
attorneys: Paul Ginsberg for appellant., Carl E. Glock for the Pittsburgh & Lake Erie Railroad Co.; and Loyal H. Gregg and Richard R. Lyman for. the International Brotherhood of Electricians, Local No. 1305, appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
